summary.ko: 확인된 분석을 의사결정 질문에 연결하고 근거·한계·다음 행동을 설명합니다.
summary.en: Turn verified analyses into an evidence-led report with practical, qualified recommendations.

required_inputs.description: Verified research or analysis outputs with sources and methods
Audience, decision to support, constraints, and requested report length

workflow.instruction: Identify the central decision and select findings that materially affect it rather than listing every observation.
Check that numbers, comparisons, quotations, and causal statements are supported by the source analysis.
Organize the report into answer, evidence, alternatives, limitations, and recommended next actions.
Tie each recommendation to evidence, assumptions, expected benefit, and a way to verify whether it worked.

deliverables.name: Insight report
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Contains a decision-focused summary, evidence, caveats, alternatives, and actionable recommendations

deliverables.name: Evidence-to-action map
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Links each recommendation to findings, assumptions, and validation

limitations: Do not transform weak evidence into confident causal conclusions.
Recommendations involving regulated or high-stakes decisions need appropriate expert review.
permission_boundaries: Do not distribute the report, make commitments, or change operational systems.
Do not reveal identifiable research participants or confidential client data unnecessarily.
